owner: data-scout for the immune-FM H4 (presentation) head — HLA-allele axis anchoring + KO-deposit HLA recovery
purpose: (1) Fetch MONO-ALLELIC immunopeptidome reference panels to anchor/prior the HLA-allele axis of the H4 presentation head; (2) set up HLA-genotype RECOVERY for KO-immunopeptidome deposits that do not report HLA. Feeds the leave-HLA-out generalization gate (leave_hla_out_gate.py) which needs >=3 distinct HLA backgrounds.
training_eligible_reason: Reference/prior + recovery-metadata artifact. Mono-allelic panels are a PRIOR/anchor for the HLA-allele axis and an evaluation aid, not a training corpus for the FM. Collection != model value; any promotion requires the H4 kill-test / leave-HLA-out advantage.

headline_coverage.note: Mono-allelic HLA-I anchor = MHCflurry-MS (177 alleles) UNION SysteMHC AlleleLibs (145 alleles) at 2-field resolution = 197. HLA-II mono-allelic = SysteMHC (139 DR/DP-pair/DQ-pair). Atlas + IEDB add reference peptides but no NEW 2-field HLA-I alleles beyond the 197; grand HLA-II union = 148 (SysteMHC 139 + atlas/IEDB DR-chain additions).

sources.name: MHCflurry 2.0 MS training data (mono-allelic HLA-I ligands)
sources.filter_applied: kept measurement_kind==mass_spec, single-allele samples only; retained HLA-* (animal MHC BoLA/H-2/Mamu excluded from allele counts)
sources.note: MHCflurry is HLA-I only by design (no class II).

sources.name: SysteMHC Atlas v2.0 (v.231201 / 230623 build) — AlleleLibs (allele-specific spectral libraries = mono-allelic by construction)
sources.fetch_method: 302 allele libraries; HTTP range-requested first 12MB of each .tar.gz to extract only the small .pepidx (peptide index) — avoided the huge .splib. 0 failures, integrity cross-checked against pepidx headers.
sources.provenance_caveat: The historical systemhcatlas.org domain is DEAD (redirects to spam). Live host is systemhc.sjtu.edu.cn (SJTU). Non-human MHC (mouse H-2, cattle BoLA, pig SLA, chicken) present in *_all_species.tsv, excluded from HLA counts.

sources.name: HLA Ligand Atlas (release 2020.12) — benign-tissue HLA-I/II ligands
sources.monoallelic_note: DONOR-based (multi-allelic donors); the atlas assigns each peptide to candidate donor alleles. Treated as an ALLELE-ANNOTATED REFERENCE / coverage layer, NOT a clean mono-allelic panel.
sources.columns: peptide, allele, source (exploded from donor_alleles, n/ w/ binder-strength prefixes stripped)

sources.name: IEDB MHC-ligand eluted-ligand (mass-spec) export
sources.monoallelic_note: Assay-level (single defined MHC restriction per record); kept only single 4-digit alleles. Reference coverage layer.
sources.full_population: 4,961,783 MS-elution records (3,573,705 class I + 1,380,695 class II)
sources.source_url: IQ-API https://query-api.iedb.org/mhc_search?assay_names=ilike.*mass spectrometry*  (bulk zip https://www.iedb.org/database_export_v3.php mhc_ligand_full.zip AVOIDED — multi-GB, over disk budget)
sources.gap: Only a bounded 100k-record alphabetical sample pulled; class-II slice DRB-biased (no DQ/DP in the window). FULL export deferred: paginate IQ-API (~500 pages of 10k) or download bulk zip on a higher-disk host. Not blocking — SysteMHC+atlas already cover HLA-II DP/DQ pairs.

s3_objects: monoallelic_ref/combined_monoallelic_hlaI_human.tsv.gz (MHCflurry UNION SysteMHC-I, dedup 1,076,812 pairs / 642,003 peptides / 201 raw alleles)

tools.route: RNA/WES/WGS HLA-I typing from NGS reads. Not installed. Acquire via bioconda (optitype) or docker (fred2/optitype). Needs razers3 + a short-read aligner + the reads.
HLA-I+II typing from RNA-seq BAM. Not installed. bioconda arcas-hla (needs an IMGT/HLA ref + samtools/pigz).
Unsupervised motif deconvolution of a peptide list into per-allele motifs. DTU Health Tech standalone download, ACADEMIC-LICENSE gated (services.healthtech.dtu.dk).
tools.used_for: MS-only typing: deconvolve multi-allele immunopeptidome into N motifs

tools.route: Allele binding prediction to ASSIGN deconvolved motifs to alleles. DTU download, academic-license gated.
tools.used_for: assign GibbsCluster motifs -> specific HLA allele

tools.route: pip install mhcflurry; mhcflurry-downloads fetch. OPEN (Apache-2.0). Recommended OPEN replacement for NetMHCpan in the assignment step.
GitHub GfellerLab/MixMHCpred + GfellerLab/MoDec. OPEN. MoDec = open motif deconvolution; MixMHCpred = open predictor. Full OPEN alternative to the GibbsCluster+NetMHCpan chain.

recommended_open_toolchains.RNA_or_WES_available: arcasHLA (RNA-seq BAM, gives HLA-I + HLA-II) or OptiType (HLA-I, robust) — both bioconda-installable; install a conda env (conda present, no docker).
recommended_open_toolchains.MS_only_no_RNA: MoDec (or GibbsCluster if license obtained) to deconvolve the eluted-ligand peptide list into N motifs (N = # expressed HLA alleles), then assign each motif to an allele with MHCflurry (HLA-I, OPEN) or MixMHCpred/NetMHCpan. The fetched mono-allelic panels ALSO serve as the per-allele motif reference for this assignment step (score deconvolved motifs against the 197-allele mono-allelic anchor).

tooling_availability.install_status_note: Nothing HLA-specific is installed locally; conda is available but no container runtime. For deposits needing MS-only deconvolution, stand up a conda env with mhcflurry (open) + MoDec (open); GibbsCluster/NetMHCpan need a DTU academic license first.

per_deposit_plan.chassis: HeLaM HLA-ABC-KO reconstituted with a single allotype
per_deposit_plan.evidence: Explicit in the deposit: raw filenames encode B4402 / B4405; PRIDE title + description + sample protocol state HLA-B*44:02 and HLA-B*44:05 (each is a separate near-mono-allelic reconstituted line on an HLA-ABC-KO background).
per_deposit_plan.recovery_method: NONE NEEDED — reported (and effectively mono-allelic per line).

per_deposit_plan.evidence: PRIDE description references 'endogenously expressed HLA alleles in HAP1 cells'. HAP1 HLA-I is a documented cell-line genotype and is recorded as the HLA background in the program's own leave_hla_out_gate dry-run (DRYRUN_leave_hla_out_gate_PXD056426.json: HAP1;HLA-A*03:01;HLA-B*51:01;HLA-C*01:02).
per_deposit_plan.recovery_method: RECOVERED FROM KNOWN CELL-LINE GENOTYPE (no imputation run needed). Optional confirmation: motif-deconvolution of the WT peptide list vs the mono-allelic anchor (A*03:01/B*51:01/C*01:02 motifs) — cheap sanity check.
per_deposit_plan.note: Some literature lists HAP1 as A*02:01/B*40:01/C*03:04; the AUTHORITATIVE value for THIS clone is the in-program dry-run genotype (A*03:01/B*51:01/C*01:02). Confirm against the paper's methods before hard-wiring; the class-I motif check resolves any ambiguity.

hla: A375 HLA-I genotype — documented cell-line type; recover from cluster metadata
per_deposit_plan.evidence: PRIDE description states W6/32 (pan-HLA-I) IP on A375 but does not list the alleles in the abstract. A375 is a well-characterized melanoma line; A375 is ALSO the chassis for PXD065279 (B2M-KO) already held in the same cluster, so its HLA-I type is documented in the ERAP1/B2M A375 study cluster and in cell-line databases (Cellosaurus/NCI-60-adjacent typing).
per_deposit_plan.recovery_method: RECOVER FROM KNOWN CELL-LINE GENOTYPE (pull A375 HLA-I from Cellosaurus / the paper's methods / the shared A375 cluster metadata). If the paper does not report it, IMPUTE via MS-only motif deconvolution (MoDec/GibbsCluster) of the WT A375 peptide list assigned against the mono-allelic anchor. No RNA/WES in the deposit -> MS-only route if needed.

per_deposit_plan.chassis: Glioblastoma lines HROG02, HROG17, RA (each +CIITA-OE and +IFN-gamma arms)
per_deposit_plan.perturbation: CIITA stable OE (induces HLA-II); HLA-I + HLA-II eluted-ligand MS
hla: Per-line HLA-I and HLA-II allotypes — characterized in the paper
per_deposit_plan.evidence: PRIDE description: 'we carefully characterized their association with the different HLA allotypes' for HROG02/HROG17/RA. The CIITA paper (PMC8724627) reports per-line HLA-I and HLA-II typing (the whole point is HLA-II epitope assignment). RECOVER the 3 lines' allotypes from the paper's supplementary HLA-typing table.
per_deposit_plan.recovery_method: RECOVER FROM PAPER (supplementary HLA-typing table lists HROG02/HROG17/RA class-I + class-II allotypes). This is the KEY HLA-II axis contributor. If any line's typing is incomplete, IMPUTE via MoDec/GibbsCluster on the (multi-allele) peptide lists assigned against the mono-allelic anchor — class-I via MHCflurry, class-II via NetMHCIIpan/the SysteMHC HLA-II AlleleLibs.

recover_from_known_line_then_impute_fall: PXD054491 (A375 known-line genotype; MS-only deconvolution fallback if unpublished)
recovery_summary.verdict: All 4 in-scope KO deposits have REPORTED or cell-line/paper-RECOVERABLE HLA. None strictly requires de-novo imputation. MS-only motif-deconvolution is set up as the FALLBACK (open toolchain: MoDec + MHCflurry + the 197-allele mono-allelic anchor as the motif reference) and as an optional confirmation for the recovered types.

hla_backgrounds_delivered_to_leave_hla_o.class_I_distinct_backgrounds: HAP1(A*03:01/B*51:01/C*01:02) + HeLaM-B*44:02 + HeLaM-B*44:05 + A375 + HROG02/HROG17/RA => >=6 distinct HLA-I backgrounds once PXD054491 + PXD020079 are typed; clears the gate's >=3-background requirement.
hla_backgrounds_delivered_to_leave_hla_o.class_II_distinct_backgrounds: HROG02/HROG17/RA (PXD020079, +CIITA) => 3 HLA-II backgrounds — the only class-II contributor in this set.

honesty_notes: Mono-allelic panels are a PRIOR/anchor + evaluation reference, not FM training data (training_eligible=false).

HLA Ligand Atlas and IEDB are donor/assay-level ALLELE-ANNOTATED references, NOT clean mono-allelic panels — labeled as such; they do not add new 2-field HLA-I alleles beyond the 197 mono-allelic set.
IEDB is a bounded SAMPLE (100k of 4.96M MS-elution records); class-II DRB-biased. Full export deferred, not blocking.

No accession or allele was invented. Cell-line genotypes flagged for confirmation against the paper methods (esp. HAP1 clone ambiguity A*03:01/B*51:01/C*01:02 vs A*02:01/B*40:01/C*03:04) before hard-wiring.

No HLA-typing tool is installed locally; conda present but no container runtime. Open toolchain (arcasHLA/OptiType for RNA-WES; MoDec+MHCflurry for MS-only) reported, not installed — install owed only if a deposit needs de-novo imputation.
